tasks.label: Build Active Module Debug x64
args: $f='${file}'; if (-not $f) { throw 'Active file is required.' }; $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $rel=[System.IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($root, $f).Replace('\','/'); if ($rel -notmatch '^Source/([^/]+)/') { throw "File is not under Source/<Module>/: $rel" }; $module=$matches[1]; $proj=Join-Path $root ("Modules/DX12.{0}.vcxproj" -f $module); if (-not (Test-Path $proj)) { throw "Module project not found: $proj" }; & 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe' $proj /t:Build /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform=x64 /p:EnableModuleDependencyValidation=false /nologo /m /v:minimal

tasks.label: Clean Root Generated Artifacts
args: Get-ChildItem -File -Filter '*.vcxproj.user' | Remove-Item -Force; Get-ChildItem -Directory -Filter 'DX12.*' | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force; if (Test-Path 'DirectX12') { Remove-Item 'DirectX12' -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path 'Intermediate') { Remove-Item 'Intermediate' -Recurse -Force }
